cwd.description: Working directory at the time of the tool call

error_summary.description: Short error description if the tool failed. Redacted and truncated to 2 KB.

event.description: Hook event name (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PreCompact, PostCompact, etc.)

files.description: File paths to fingerprint (size + mtime + content hash)

input.description: Tool input. Hashed and never stored raw; redacted metadata is only stored when retain_details is true.

output.description: Tool output. Same redaction and storage policy as input.

retain_details.description: If true, redacted input and output payloads are stored alongside hashes. Defaults to false.

session_id.description: Session identifier for grouping related events

tool.description: Tool name being observed (Bash, Edit, Write, etc.)
